Our Story

Grill it.
Share it.

Not your average K-BBQ. We fire up real charcoal, so the meat gets that smoky edge you can't fake with gas.

Step into a room that feels like a late-night pojangmacha in Seoul: warm wood, lantern light, and tables that make a meal feel like an evening out. Every table has a built-in grill, and our team keeps the banchan coming, from kimchi to seasoned anchovies to pickled radish.

Our sauces are made by hand every day with fresh fruits and vegetables, and our meat is premium quality, chosen for flavor and tenderness.

Whether it's a Tuesday lunch special or a birthday night for a big group, we keep it easy: pick a set, light the grill, and take your time. You have two hours at the table, and we'll make sure it's a good two.

  • Cooking styleReal charcoal grill
  • Table grillsBuilt in, every table
  • Dining formatPremium All You Can Eat
  • Dining time2-hour seating
  • BanchanKimchi, anchovies & more

The Experience

Three things
we do well.

01

Charcoal, Not Gas

Our tabletop grills run on real charcoal for a clean, smoky sear. Meat cooks faster, tastes richer, and the room smells like the real thing.

02

Seoul Street Mood

Stools, wood tables, and warm lights, inspired by the pojangmacha tents of Korea. Come for dinner, stay until the night gets late.

03

Eat Until You're Happy

Our all-you-can-eat sets cover prime beef, pork, chicken, and seafood, plus rice, cold noodles, and stews you can order at your table.

Banchan and a built-in grill at every table. Stews can be ordered at your table.
